references.text: Proverbs 11:8 gives the theological explanation of why Lot was saved while Sodom was destroyed: the righteous is delivered, while the wicked comes in his place.
Proverbs 21:12 describes the theological dynamic that Lot experienced: the righteous observes how the wicked are brought to ruin.
Proverbs 11:6 formulates the theological principle underlying the Lot event: righteousness delivers the righteous.
